description: This file defines models and a fetcher class for searching CBOE indices, including query parameters, data structures, and data transformation methods.

classes.name: CboeIndexSearchQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for CBOE index search, including cache usage.

classes.name: CboeIndexSearchData
classes.description: Represents the data structure for CBOE index search results, with field aliases and optional attributes.

classes.name: CboeIndexSearchFetcher
classes.description: Handles data fetching and transformation from CBOE endpoints, including query transformation and data processing.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a CboeIndexSearchQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches and filters index data from CBOE, returning a list of records.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw data dictionaries into validated CboeIndexSearchData instances.
